text:
liz: Heads-up — assembling release notes for docs v0.9.2. Main asks: (1) update SDK snippets for streaming API (python/js), (2) add a short known-issue blurb about streaming truncation when using multiline prompts, (3) verify links for migration guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2147 Please ping with quick ack + who will own snippet changes. Thanks :wave:

ben: I can take Python snippets. I'll swap to the new `stream=True` pattern and add example for reconnect logic. ETA EOD. Link to my draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2150

ashley: I'll do JS and the CLI examples. Need to confirm whether we should show both callback style and async iterator. Preference for async iterator for new docs. :+1:

sanjay: For the known issue, here's the short blurb I suggest:

```
Known issue: Streaming responses may stop prematurely when the prompt contains consecutive blank lines (\n\n) or long prefixed system content. We're tracking a fix; workaround: trim consecutive blank lines or use non-streamed responses for long prompts.
```

liz: That looks good. Can we quantify? Any internal repro steps/limits? e.g., token counts that trigger it.

sanjay: Repro: send a 600-token system message with repeated `\n\n` separators; streaming often halts around 2048 tokens. Not deterministic but repeatable in some cases. Filed internal bug: INC-5923 (link: https://go/redwood/inc/INC-5923)

maria: Quick note: Update the migration guide section "Embedding migration v1->v2" — some redirect links were stale (old /embed endpoint). I'll sweep links and add redirects note. I'll open a small PR.

ben: Added the python snippet update in my PR, plus a tiny note about using `client.stream()` vs `client.generate()`. PTAL @liz

liz: sweet. Can someone also add a small "How to test" section for QA with the steps sanjay mentioned? We want QA to confirm the workaround.

ashley: I'll add a checklist: 1) reproduce with sample prompt, 2) try trimmed prompt, 3) compare streaming vs non-streaming latency.

dev-docs-bot: Build preview for PR 2147 available at https://deploy-preview-2147--docs.redwood.ai (status: success)

liz: Perfect — I'll merge the PR after the snippet owners finish edits and QA signs off. Target roll tomorrow morning. Add a short blurb to release notes: "Fixed: updated SDK streaming examples; Known-issue: intermittent streaming truncation with multiline prompts" — should be concise.

sanjay: Also note: routing fallback might cause different model variant; add a line to release notes: "Note: customers using Dedicated may observe fallback to 2x quantized variant under low capacity — behavior unchanged but can affect streaming behavior." Keep it short.

liz: Got it. Final owners: ben (python), ashley (js+cli), maria (migration links), sanjay (known-issue repro & internal bug link). Will update thread with QA checklist and merges. Thanks everyone :tada:
